summary: A good Chiang Mai weekend morning if you want breakfast, local produce and handmade goods in one relaxed stop. Jing Jai’s farmers market and craft market are separate parts of the same site, so browse for food as well as locally made gifts; treat it as an open-ended outing rather than a scheduled attraction.
whyGo: Combine breakfast and coffee with browsing fresh produce, prepared food, baked goods and crafts.
The operator describes the market as a community venue supporting local farmers, makers and designers.
bestFor: Travellers who enjoy food markets and a slow morning
People looking for locally made crafts and edible souvenirs
Families or friends who want an informal outing
skipIf: Your Chiang Mai stay has no Saturday or Sunday morning and you specifically want the full weekend market
You need a quiet visit, fixed-price advance booking or a tightly timed attraction
duration: Allow 1.5–3 hours as a planning estimate, depending on breakfast and shopping.
cost: No admission fee is listed by the tourism board. Food, drinks and purchases cost extra; current stall prices and payment methods were not verified.
hours: The operator’s market page lists Saturday and Sunday, 06:30–15:00. A separate operator article describes the main farmers and craft zones as running 06:30–13:00, so arrive in the morning and check close to your date.
bestTime: Aim for about 07:30–10:00 for the broadest breakfast and browsing window; this is a planning suggestion, not a guarantee that every stall opens at the same time.
gettingThere: Set your destination to Jing Jai Market, 45 Atsadathon Road, Pa Tan, Chiang Mai. A taxi or ride-hail from central Chiang Mai is a straightforward option; parking is listed by the Tourism Authority of Thailand, but weekend availability was not verified. Exact public-transport connections were not confirmed.
booking: Walk-in visit; no reservation process is listed for the market. Check separately for any special event or workshop you plan to attend.
accessibility: The site lists parking and restrooms, but step-free routes, accessible toilets, path surfaces and stall access were not documented in the sources reviewed. Contact the operator if you need specific access arrangements.
practicalTips: Bring a reusable bag and some cash; individual stall payment options may vary.
Ask vendors directly about ingredients and allergens before ordering.
Go earlier if produce is your priority; the full market programme is a morning activity even though the operator lists hours to 15:00.
decemberNotes: For December 2026, choose a Saturday or Sunday morning. No dated December 2026 programme or holiday closure notice was verified. Recheck the operator’s page or social channels shortly before going, particularly because its published end time differs between pages.
uncertainties: The operator lists 06:30–15:00 on the market page but 06:30–13:00 for the core zones in a separate article; individual stall hours may vary.
December 2026 special events, holiday exceptions, stall prices, transport fares and detailed accessibility provisions were not confirmed.
